entries.scope: G3 no-IALMob Id-Vg, Vd=0.1 V, exact SProcess topology, Vg=0--5 V; dominant unresolved interval Vg=0--0.6667 V
entries.observation: The qualified contact-boundary ElectricField HFS fallback reduces the three-point fixed-state median error from 1.04443 dex to 0.0196168 dex. After repairing the constant_field cached-mobility Jacobian, all 31 no-predictor points converge and the worst KCL relative error is 7.96e-6, but the self-consistent P95 current error is 0.432753 dex and the fixed-current equivalent threshold shift is 43.2055 mV. Vg=0.1667--0.6667 V retains a nearly multiplicative Vela/Sentaurus current factor of 2.61--2.73. An eight-combination psi/phin/phip frozen-state audit attributes a median 0.403147 dex, or 2.53015x, amplification to self-consistent state feedback; phin is the dominant single family at all four audited biases. At Vg=0.3333--0.6667 V the fixed Sentaurus-state operator ratio is only 1.046--1.049, while the full self-consistent ratio is 2.606--2.731. A Vg=0.5 V read-only region-local interface-pair probe removes oxide-side box contributions from carrier flux only: interface hotspots 3747, 10233, and 4538 improve to 2.04e-5x, 0.157x, and 5.37e-4x of baseline, respectively, proving a local interface-coupling semantic gap. However, the full free-row residual L2 and maximum improve only to 0.650x and 0.895x because silicon-only node 4492 is unchanged. A direct T-2022.03-SP2 MeasureCoefficients.debug audit now closes node 4492 from 5.40895e-7 to 1.31409e-10 (0.000242948x) by replaying the AverageBox edge coefficients, while the one-ring L2 improves only to 0.890554x and the maximum moves to node 10235. A loadable-state one-Newton probe shows Sentaurus node 4492 delta-psi of -3.64e-17 V versus Vela 1.70682e-3 V, excluding state precision as the local cause. The frozen global 2x gate still fails and no self-consistent reclose is authorized. This is not yet an approved engine floor.

mixed-Voronoi node volume in fixed-state SG replay
barycentric versus truncated negative-cotangent coupling in same-bias reclose
removing oxide-side box contributions from interface carrier edges as a sufficient global closure for the Vg=0.5 V fixed state
a density-state or restart-precision mismatch as the silicon-only node 4492 residual cause
a uniform node-4492 incident-edge scaling as a sufficient one-ring closure
uniform psi or hole-QF state feedback as the subthreshold current-amplitude cause
SRH or Auger recombination magnitude as the electron-continuity hotspot cause
drain-side anomalous couple-over-length edges as the dominant remaining feedback location
WP1.5 low-current KCL and line-search floor
missing contact-boundary ElectricField fallback as the sole remaining cause
constant_field cached-mobility Jacobian mismatch as a physical curve-amplitude cause
open_causes: production representation of region-local Si/SiO2 interface carrier degrees of freedom; a read-only pair probe proves local benefit but fails the global reclose gate
full-mesh LDMOS AverageBox external-coefficient replay; node 4492 closes locally but its one-ring residual transfers to node 10235 and fails the 2x gate
electron-QF edge support and density-averaging semantics that create the localized self-consistent feedback
direct LDMOS AverageBox coefficient impact at nodes 3747, 10233, and 4538 using the now-archived complete MeasureCoefficients oracle
generalized SRH hole-QF reference convention; low impact on current Id-Vg but material for recombination qualification
entries.expires_when: A full-mesh LDMOS AverageBox external-coefficient replay plus source-side Si/SiO2 electron-continuity first-Newton-step audits either close the phin feedback without hotspot transfer or prove a mesh-converged engine difference; generalized SRH reference semantics are independently requalified, or the exact mesh/discretization contract changes.
